section.content: This disclosure relates to semiconductor integrated circuit.It provides a kind of for reducing the technology of the power consumption of Content Addressable Memory (CAM) system.In CAM system, equalizing circuit is coupled to by dividing the boundary portion between the multiple matched line parts generated corresponding to each matched line of an entry data, and each of the matched line part jointly corresponding to an entry data is pre-charged to voltage VDD or VSS by pre-charge circuit.When comparing entry data and search data, after matched line part is precharged circuit precharge, equalizing circuit couples the matched line part according to control signal.In balancing period, the search operation of scounting line is begun through.Search transistor for comparison search data and entry data includes NMOS search transistor.

本公开涉及半导体集成电路。提供了一种用于减小内容可寻址存储器(CAM)系统的功耗的技术。在CAM系统中，均衡电路被耦连到通过划分对应于一条条目数据的每一个匹配线而产生的多个匹配线部分之间的边界部，并且预充电电路将共同对应于一条条目数据的匹配线部分中的每一个预充电到电压VDD或者VSS。当比较条目数据和搜索数据时，在匹配线部分被预充电电路预充电之后，均衡电路根据控制信号耦连所述匹配线部分。在均衡时段，开始通过搜索线的搜索操作。用于比较搜索数据和条目数据的搜索晶体管包括NMOS搜索晶体管。

Technical field

This disclosure relates to a kind of semiconductor integrated circuit including Content Addressable Memory (CAM) and for reducing power consumption Technology.

Background technique

Other than for reading and writing the function of data, CAM has the search function for searching for the data being stored therein Energy.

In order to write data into CAM, data are transferred to bit line (BL), and at the same time being corresponded to by row decoder activation Data are by the wordline for the address being written to.

In CAM, by based on search serial data activation scounting line (SL) and determine search data whether with cam array In entry data match to scan for.When through search discovery matching entry, this destination address is exported.Entry storage As the data word of search target, and including multiple CAM cells.Each entry is provided with matched line (ML), corresponding CAM Unit is coupled to the matched line by parallel connection.When search serial data and storage data word in the entry are compared and are found When matching each other, the matched line corresponding to the entry is maintained as high level.As comparison result, when finding them each other not When matching, corresponding matched line discharges into low level.

As described, it can be determined by identifying the potential level of matched line with whether the data of search Data Matching store In CAM.

When finding multiple entries and search Data Matching in CAM, entry that output is selected by priority encoder it One address.

Be used for such as route search similar to CAM recited above, for example, as in the network equipment router and friendship It changes planes, and cache-miss or hit for determining cache memory.For example, network router includes using In the CAM of IP (Internet protocol) grouping routing.The CAM stores IP address, and by the IP address that inputs from the outside and depositing IP address of the storage in CAM, which is compared, to be routed.When finding to match as comparison result, next destination is indicated Data IP packet is written to based on the information obtained from corresponding matched line, then send the IP packet.

When executing search operation in CAM, the matched line being included therein is electrically charged or discharges, thus the function of CAM Consumption increases.In addition, when including that matched line in CAM is precharged, it is necessary to scounting line are reset to VSS, to prevent passing through Wear the generation of electric current.That is, scounting line is electrically charged/discharges, to increase the function of CAM whenever executing search operation in CAM Consumption.Therefore, in order to reduce the power consumption of CAM, it is necessary to which reduction includes the power consumption of the scounting line and matched line in CAM.

Summary of the invention

The peak point current in power consumption and CAM in order to reduce CAM, is studying various technologies.It is related to the technology packet of CAM It includes, for example, Japanese Unexamined Patent Application Publication No.2009-110616 (patent document 1) and Japanese Unexamined Patent Application Publication Technology disclosed in No.2002-358791 (patent document 2).

In the embodiment introduced in above-mentioned patent document, CAM system includes: the first CAM cell, the first CAM cell packet Include PMOS (positive NMOS N-channel MOS N) the search transistor for being coupled to the first matched line；And second CAM cell, Two CAM cells include NMOS (negative NMOS N-channel MOS N) the search transistor for being coupled to the second matched line.With first The first and second matched lines coupled respectively with the second CAM cell when relevant search result be mismatch when they are discharged into Potential in terms of it is different.When corresponding to include the search result of the first CAM cell of PMOS search transistor is mismatch, with the One CAM cell, which couples and is precharged to the first matched line of intermediate electric potential, is discharged into the first potential (VDD).That is, first The first potential (VDD) is presented in matched line.When the search result for corresponding to the second CAM cell including NMOS search transistor is to lose Timing, couples with the second CAM cell and the second matched line for being precharged to intermediate electric potential is discharged into the second potential (VSS).That is, the second potential (VSS) is presented in the second matched line.

Therefore, when search result is mismatch, the first matched line and the second matched line are different in terms of potential.Therefore, CAM System cannot start search operation, until making the first matched line and the second matched line equilibrium to generate intermediate electric potential and again After secondary division matched line.For example, it is assumed that when the first matched line and the second matched line just by equilibrium when, CAM system, which has activated, to be searched Bands.In this case, if search result on both the first matched line and the second matched line becomes mismatch simultaneously, first Matched line and the second matched line discharge into the first potential (VDD) and the second potential (VSS) respectively, and two matched lines are kept each other Coupling.This generates the short circuit between the first potential (VDD) of the first matched line and the second potential (GND) of the second matched line, In two matched lines be coupled together by equalizing circuit.

Think in the CAM system for being mainly used for searching for particular ip address, most of search results are mismatches.Therefore, such as Fruit in the first matched line and the second matched line just by equilibrium when CAM system activate scounting line, it is however very well possible to short circuit occurs, and can Chip can be damaged.Therefore, it is necessary to postpone scounting line activation, until matched line is balanced, and then have been divided.This delay The subsequent inductive operation executed by adapter amplifier, to reduce the frequency of search operation.In addition, with the NMOS of identical size Transistor is compared, and the source-drain current of PMOS transistor is smaller, in order to suitable with NMOS transistor in performance, needs to compare The big PMOS transistor of NMOS transistor.In the embodiment disclosed in above-mentioned patent document, in order to enable including that PMOS is searched for First CAM cell of transistor and including NMOS search transistor the second CAM cell operated with identical search operation frequency, It must generally make PMOS search transistor bigger.Which increase chip areas, and therefore increase chip cost.Because this Also make that two kinds of CAM cell must be designed, increases the cost of design and processes exploitation.

In the presence of so that including the faster demand of search operation of the semiconductor integrated circuit of CAM.Therefore, it is necessary to reduce including Power consumption in the semiconductor integrated circuit of CAM and the technology for further speeding up search operation.

From the description of following the specification and drawings, it will become apparent that other purposes and novel feature of the invention.

The semiconductor integrated circuit of embodiment according to the present invention has Content Addressable Memory device.The semiconductor Integrated circuit includes memory cell array, equalizing circuit and pre-charge circuit.The memory cell array includes multiple deposits Storage unit, each memory cell is coupled to scounting line and matched line, and multiple matched lines are coupled to the memory Unit.The equalizing circuit is coupled to by dividing between multiple matched line parts that each of described matched line generates Boundary portion, each of described matched line correspond to an entry data.Pre-charge circuit will correspond to an entry jointly The matched line part of data is pre-charged.When comparing entry data and search data, pre-charge circuit will be by the equalizing circuit Each of matched line part of division is pre-charged at least the first potential and different from the second potential of the first potential One.When comparing entry data and search data, after matched line part is precharged circuit precharge, equalizing circuit root The matched line part is coupled according to control signal.

The semiconductor integrated circuit of embodiment according to the present invention, the matched line corresponding to an entry data are divided into Multiple portions, and the multiple part is arranged by equalizing circuit to intermediate electric potential.This matched line portion that it is only necessary to will divide One in point is pre-charged to the potential of the matched line part potential higher than other divisions, so as to reduce the semiconductor collection At the power consumption of circuit.
